journeys.title: First visit and access
journeys.summary: An invitation establishes intended access; the institution verifies identity. The first task comes after role and course context are known.

journeys.title: Learn, submit and receive feedback
journeys.summary: The receipt ends the student submission. Grading and release are separate staff actions; a dashed handoff never grants the student staff access.

journeys.title: Build an accessible lesson
journeys.summary: Author content, select an accessible resource, save in the module and preview the learner view before publication.

journeys.title: Create coursework and a rubric
journeys.summary: The reusable rubric and assignment instructions become learner-visible only through the publication workflow.

journeys.title: Author a quiz, attempt it and release results
journeys.summary: A submitted attempt keeps its question, answer and timing snapshot. Later authoring changes affect future attempts. Reference-feedback release follows the captured rule.

journeys.title: Grade, change a rubric and reconcile records
journeys.summary: Review each answer, preserve overrides, approve the exact release, then reconcile the separate official-record handoff.

journeys.title: Apply an approved learner allowance
journeys.summary: Operational adjustments change the learner’s effective dates. Private documentation stays outside the course workflow.

journeys.title: Resolve a class meeting change
journeys.summary: A proposal moves through constraint review and approval; only the authoritative applied change updates the student calendar.

journeys.title: Find and reserve a room
journeys.summary: Search, request and confirmation are different steps. Recurrence exceptions stay tied to the right occurrence.

journeys.title: Plan an event and welcome students
journeys.summary: Officer, room staff, event approver and participant each have their own step. RSVP, waitlist and offline check-in retain distinct states.

journeys.title: Transfer an organization without losing work
journeys.summary: The incoming role updates the roster, contact and open tasks; the organization keeps its drafts and records.

journeys.title: Connect a student to a human service
journeys.summary: A faculty/adviser handoff enters a coordinator queue. The student sees service, owner and next step, not private staff notes.

journeys.title: Set up, migrate and accept a course
journeys.summary: IT maps and reconciles sources; faculty reviews a separate destination course; the institution accepts the scoped implementation.

journeys.title: Find the right service or technical help
journeys.summary: Search respects access. Academic support and technical product issues route to different responsible teams.

journeys.title: Manage your profile and updates
journeys.summary: Account context and notification choices are connected without creating a second task inbox.

sharedNavigation.rule: From every signed-in workspace: account and profile, global search, technical help, and update preferences remain available. Search results and deep links are permission-scoped. Closing a shared tool returns to the originating workspace and role context; Today is only the student default. Signing out or an expired session returns through institution sign-in and restores the allowed destination.
